interface.longDescription:
The agentic video editor for serious creatives. Don't waste time on AI you have to babysit. Do what you love while invideo's AI agents handle the rest.

Bring your own agents. Connect the agent you already use to invideo's editor. It trims, grades and mixes on your timeline while you watch every change land. Upload footage, describe the edit, review the cut, export.

No need to become a prompt engineer. You're an editor, not an AI expert. Describe the edit in plain words, and invideo's editing agent does it on a real multitrack timeline you can take over at any frame.

Edit multiple shots in one go. Nobody wants to make the same change on forty clips by hand. Give invideo's editing agent one direction and it applies it to every shot on the timeline, from cutting the pauses to matching the look.

Never repeat yourself. Life's too short to scrub through hours of footage for one take. invideo's editing agent watches every clip and logs it in memory, so you find any moment by describing it.

Timeline editor: picture Premiere Pro with full AI. Multiplayer mode: collaborate in real time with live cursors. Storyboarding and script writing built in. Filmmaking, advertising, microdrama and social media: direct every shot, stay on brand across every format, and spin one idea into dozens of vertical cuts.

Private and secure. SOC 2 and GDPR compliant, ISO aligned.
capabilities: Trims, grades and mixes on a real multitrack timeline you can take over at any frame
Applies one direction to every shot: cut the pauses, match the look
Finds any moment in hours of footage by describing it
Storyboarding, script writing, captions, voice-over and music
Export vertical cuts for every channel, on brand across every format
defaultPrompt: Duck the music under the voice-over and write the captions
